name: johnvc LinkedIn Jobs API
description: Public LinkedIn job listings as structured JSON: search by keyword, location, seniority and job type, or fetch job URLs, and get title, company, location, salary, description and apply link. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; the tool is the pay-per-job Apify Actor johnvc/linkedin-jobs-api. Sign in with an Apify account (OAuth).
author: johnvc
